output.summary: The user requires that any sign-on bonus repayment obligation expires by Month 12 to ensure leaving at Month 18 triggers no clawback. The decision packet's Clause 6b explicitly states the repayment obligation amortizes 1/12th per completed month and drops to $0 after Month 12. Since the user plans to leave at Month 18, which is well beyond the 12-month expiration point, the repayment obligation will be zero. The net after-tax payout figure is consistent with the gross bonus and standard withholding assumptions. All stated constraints regarding the repayment timeline are satisfied.
key_claims: Repayment obligation drops to $0 after Month 12
User plans to leave at Month 18
